{{Quote|He can't resist boasting to me. Soon we'll be able to afford whatever we want. A luxury cruiser for our trips to Nuralee. A villa by the Sea of Translucency on Dremulae.|Astri Oddo|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sea of Translucency''' was a sea that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dremulae]].

The sea was a popular galactic tourist attraction, even for those luxury-travelers wishing to opt for a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] simulation experience—a sim-vacation, or [[Sim-vacation|sim-voyage]].

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Astri Oddo]] mentioned that her husband, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bog Divinian]], had claimed that he would soon be wealthy enough to purchase a villa located next to the Sea of Translucency.
